text.p: -EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it upgraded its rating on Burnham Pacific Properties Inc to a long-term outperform from a market perform. It maintained its medium-term rating of outperform.
-The upgrade was based on Burnham's accelerated growth rate on funds from operations and its improved business plan, EVEREN said.
-EVEREN said it has a near-term price target of $15.50 and a long-term of $16.00 for the stock.
-The company on Monday reported first quarter funds from operations of $0.29 a share versus $0.32 a share last year, in line with expectations.
-During the quarter, Burnham acquired six properties, and EVEREN said the "pipeline for acquisitions continues to be strong for BPP in the West Coast markets they have targeted".
